Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs — clarification: controller/processor roles and export paths

Asha / Marissa —

Quick follow-up on a couple of points that will change the redline approach on the Order Form:

1) Controller vs Processor: if Helix will assert controller responsibilities for the dataset and only uses Redwood for inference calls (no profile building, no model fine-tuning on Helix data), we can keep the standard processor template. If Helix plans to store derivative data or use our APIs to build models on customer data, we will need a joint-controller addendum. Please indicate which model applies.

2) Export paths / cross-border transfers: Helix's filled request shows EU data, can you confirm whether the EU data will be routed to our EU region (recommended) or whether you require US-region hosting? If you require US-region hosting plus SCCs for export, note that we will attach the SCCs exhibit and an export-impact addendum. That path will also require a brief subprocessor-by-region disclosure.

3) Retention clause mapping: Helix asked to limit logs/records to 90 days in the order form redline — we can agree for operational logs, but for audit and compliance logs we will propose a 12-month retention with redaction options. Please confirm which categories Helix wants covered by the 90-day cap.

For speed, if you can reply inline in the attached Helix_DPA_Request_Form (we'll re-ingest the PDF) we will incorporate the answers into the consolidated redline.

-Karthik
Legal Ops / Contracting, Redwood Inference
